creative_brief.pacing: Fast-paced vertical reel cadence; 3.0 to 3.5 seconds per scene to sustain technical viewer retention
creative_brief.transitions: Clean hard cuts simulating quick IDE tab switches and terminal command executions

creative_brief.rationale: Developer audiences on Reels and Shorts respond to realistic CLI output and hard telemetry rather than generic stock footage. Dark-mode terminals provide high contrast on mobile screens.
